execution_status: Authorized supplementary exploratory comparison; specified after source inspection, before model fitting; see prediction_receipt.json for execution
scope: Retrospective Swiss observed harvest-yield prediction within the recorded cultivar and 2019-2020 management domain
registration_status: Specified after source/schema/coverage inspection and before any model fit; local protocol, not external preregistration
target: yield_t_ha: source yield_dtha multiplied by 0.1; retained package reports 15% grain moisture
cohort: All 724 unique Swiss plot IDs with recorded STB and harvest yield; no outcome-based exclusions
estimator: Ridge, unpenalized intercept, fixed alpha=1.0, training-fold categorical one-hot encoding and density standardization; no tuning
unseen_categories: All-zero encoding; counts exported for every fold/model/feature
training_weights: Each training site-year has equal total weight; weights normalized to sum to the training plot count
metrics: Primary RMSE and MAE: average error within site-year, then equally across site-years; pooled plot metrics also retained
primary_contrast: management_stb minus management in held-out squared error
uncertainty: 10,000 paired bootstrap resamples of the five site-level OOF error contrasts (each site averages its two years), seed 20261009; descriptive stability interval conditional on fitted folds, not a confirmatory CI or p-value
exclusion_reason: Harvest-derived measurements leak outcomes; heading/height lack timing relative to the undated disease score; identifiers are grouping/provenance fields, not covariates
france: No environmental transfer fit: one site-year, early ordinal score followed by fungicides, spatial BLUPs fitted across the experiment; raw yields audited separately
interpretation_limits: Ordinal scores remain categories; no equal-interval or percent-leaf-area conversion.
Disease assessment dates are absent; predictions are retrospective associations, not validated prospective forecasts.
Repeated cultivars across sites are allowed; this does not test unseen-cultivar prediction.
Two seasons do not establish temporal or future-climate transfer; site-year folds share locations across training and test.
Sowing density is site-confounded; management coefficients do not identify intervention effects.
The co-disease sensitivity addresses recorded ratings only; residual confounding remains.
No HAD, STB-specific yield-loss fraction, regional tonnes, adaptation benefit, or physiological grain model is validated.
